We focus on a collection of organisational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance that help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organisations in order to keep up with the changing nature of customers and technology. We make impactful decisions by mixing mind and machine to leverage data, understand and navigate risk, and help our clients gain a competitive edge.
  
  
Creating business intelligence from data requires an understanding of the business, the data, and the technology used to store and analyse that data. Using our Rapid Business Intelligence Solutions, data visualisation and integrated reporting dashboards, we can deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to more effectively run their business and understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the answers.
  
  
  
Exp- 4-7yrs
  
Location- PAN India 
  
  
1.) Designing and implementing data models and schemas to support reporting and analysis in Power BI.

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and configure SAP Signavio solutions including Process Manager, Process Intelligence, Journey Modeler, and Collaboration Hub.
* Conduct process discovery, process mapping, process mining, and process optimization workshops.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify improvement opportunities.
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformation programs using SAP Signavio methodologies.
* Define process KPIs, governance frameworks, and best practices.

title: Tableau CRM Analytics
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) dashboards and datasets.
* Build highly interactive and performance-optimized dashboards using CRMA dashboard components and JSON customization.
* Develop complex business logic and analytical queries using SAQL and SQL.
* Create, schedule, and optimize Data Syncs, Dataflows, and Recipes for efficient data processing.Implement advanced data modeling, joins, and cogrouping techniques across multiple datasets.
* Ensure data security by configuring Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance for row-level access control.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Optimize dashboard performance, query execution, and data pipeline efficiency.
* Work closely with Salesforce Administrators, Developers, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to deliver analytics solutions.
* Manage CRMA data ingestion from Salesforce objects, ensuring accurate mapping of fields and data types.Troubleshoot dashboard, dataset, and dataflow issues while maintaining data quality and governance.Follow best practices for CRMA development, deployment, and performance tuning.

**Your Profile**

* Required 5-8 years of experienced Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) Developer to design, build, and optimize enterprise-level dashboards and data pipelines.
* Having experience in developing high-performance CRMA dashboards by customizing JSON structures, navigating CRMA’s unique architecture and limitations compared to tools like Tableau.
* Experienced in building advanced query using SAQL and SQL (utilizing CRMA-specific cogrouping), managing data engineering via optimized Data Syncs, Dataflows, and Recipes, and enforcing strict row-level security using Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance.
* To succeed, should have deep understanding of core Salesforce fundamentals, including objects, permission sets, data types, and how CRMA ingests platform data.
* Primary Skills (Must-Have)CRMA Dashboarding: Deep knowledge of CRMA dashboard limitations and capabilities vs. Tableau.JSON Customization: Hands-on experience editing dashboard JSON for advanced layouts and steps.SAQL Expertise: Advanced scripting in Salesforce Analytics Query Language for complex logic.Data Pipelines: Building, scheduling, and optimizing Recipes, Dataflows, and Data Syncs.Recipe Optimization: Ability to split data recipes by execution frequency to maximize performance.Row-Level Security: Implementing Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance within CRMA.
* Secondary Skills (Highly Preferred)Core Salesforce Architecture: Solid grasp of standard/custom objects, fields, and permission sets.CRMA Data Mapping: Deep understanding of how Salesforce data types ingest and translate into CRMA.SQL & Complex Joins: Strong background in relational database joins to accelerate data modelling.Cogrouping Mastery: Understanding CRMA-specific multi-dataset joining techniques that differ from traditional SQL.

* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.

* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a Sr. Business Analyst to join the Field Compensation and Incentives team, responsible for translating business needs into actionable data, reporting, and analytics solutions. This role will play a key part in supporting day\-to\-day operations of multiple business programs, delivering recurring and ad hoc reporting, and performing in\-depth analysis to drive business insights. The role will also own multiple process improvement initiatives across programs and teams.
